Fixture Corp annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023.

Item 1. Business

Fixture Corp designs and sells widgets in three segments: Industrial, Consumer and Services. Our largest customer accounted for 12% of revenue in fiscal 2023.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

See Item 7. for a discussion of liquidity. Demand for widgets is cyclical and may decline.

  • Supply chain concentration in one region.
  • Foreign currency exposure.
